# M2 standard display fixture

The TJS, PNG checkerboard and JPEG solid-color image are authored for TwinQuill
and licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. They contain no game assets. `drawText`
uses the separately audited Noto Sans CJK SC fallback font bundled by the app.

Launch through SAF. Expected: PNG checkerboard, green JPEG, yellow English and
Chinese text, a translucent red rectangle and a blinking Timer badge. Tap the
red rectangle: it becomes opaque green. Home/task return and Activity recreation
preserve that state. Press Enter on the emulator keyboard to close the Window;
Android Back also exits normally.
